title: Zephyr: position beacon broadcast (interval: 60s moving, 300s stationary)
description: Broadcast position at variable intervals based on motion state
notes: Implemented Zephyr position beacon scheduling in the existing clean coap_location module without touching externally owned CoAP/SenML wiring. Adds deterministic monotonic poll API plus delayed-work start/stop, default 60s moving and 300s stationary cadence, distance-based movement entry and two-sample stationary hysteresis, HAL freshness/source gating, public-only beacon privacy gating per position_privacy_auth vector, bounded 192-byte SenML-CBOR payload, NON PUT /pos to ff02::1:5683 with interface scope, injectable transport, and bounded retry/backpressure/stat counters with overflow/rollback checks. Focused local Zephyr 4.1 qemu_x86 test: 6/6 PASS, 0 fail/skip (intervals/hysteresis, payload fields/bounds, privacy/no-fix, retry exhaustion, multicast request, invalid/monotonic boundaries). Post-format rebuild PASS and git diff --check clean. QEMU runner required its standard SLIP listener; execution was bounded and reported PROJECT EXECUTION SUCCESSFUL.
